site.name: Md. Ibrahim Hossain
site.tagline: Full-stack engineer crafting fast, accessible interfaces and the systems behind them.

availability.message: Open to product work, frontend-leaning roles, and interesting collaborations.

bio.short: I build products at the intersection of thoughtful UI and solid engineering — currently shipping Shopify apps at Zepto Apps.
bio.long: I'm a software engineer based in Dhaka. I spend most of my time in the React / Remix / Node neighbourhood, and I enjoy the work that sits between design and infrastructure — the part where a real product actually has to feel good to use. Lately I've been building merchant tooling for Shopify, including a live app that lets retailers sell custom neon signs with per-character design controls.
bio.pullQuote: The interesting problems are usually the ones where design, UX, and state management all have opinions at the same time.
